runner.algorithm: Recursively remove only executed_at, elapsed_seconds and wall_seconds, including within arrays. Sort JSON object keys and compare exact serialized values, including floating-point values and numerical types; no tolerance.

portable_corrected_jst.original_problem: Frozen experiment has literal source-checkout absolute CSV pathname. Original fresh-* run resolved outside clone. It is excluded as evidence of self-contained input.

budget_after.accounting: Declared-core x runner wall time. Excludes builds, idle time and other sessions; not the GitHub bill or remaining account allowance.

budget_before.accounting: Declared-core x runner wall time. Excludes builds, idle time and other sessions; not the GitHub bill or remaining account allowance.

budget_after.accounting: Declared-core x runner wall time. Excludes builds, idle time and other sessions; not the GitHub bill or remaining account allowance.

household_observations.meaning: NBS household survey same-period mean ratio, not national-accounts savings rate or bank cash change; reconstructed prior year approximate because reported growth rounded

equity_cny.interpretation: Index NET dividend-withholding convention, not all household fees/taxes; December monthly-average CPI approximates year-end purchasing power. Rounded published annual returns and 2025 CPI limit precision. Historical observation does not predict a future ten-year window.

household.source: Freshly generated 1,500-row strategy CSV, grouped independently by strategy and scenario. Distinct trajectory IDs are the engine's full-path groupings.
